name: Homunculist (Artificer Archetype)
body:
Artificers are also well known to be creators of constructs. Some however, delve deeper and create life from inert material. These are the homunculists.

Homunculus Familiar (Ex)

At 1st level, you create a living homunculus in the shape of an animal or vermin. This functions in all ways as a wizard’s familiar, using the homunculist’s class level as their effective wizard level. Additionally, at 5th level, the homunculist gains the Evolved Familiar feat as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.

This ability replaces scribe scroll and retain charge.

Experimentation (Ex)

Whenever the homunculist gains a bonus metamagic or item creation feat, they can instead gain Evolved Familiar as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. This ability modifies bonus item creation feat and bonus metamagic feat but does not preclude those abilities being replaced by another archetype.
